root_cause: ACL 101 has no permit for DNS return traffic, so replies from external resolvers are dropped.

evidence.quote: 10 permit tcp any host 203.0.113.2 eq 22 (0 matches)
evidence.why: The only explicit permit line never matches, suggesting the ACL isn't allowing the traffic it should.
ACL 101 is the one filtering this interface's inbound traffic.

fix_steps: Add a permit udp entry for the DNS response port (eq 53)
verification_steps: Re-test DNS resolution from a host behind R1
Confirm the new permit line increments
risk_notes: Adding an overly broad permit could reopen traffic the ACL was meant to block.
